text:
maria: heads-up — seeing a 3-4ms tail-latency hill on Mistral-8x7B when sequences cross ~512->520 tokens. baseline stable until ~512 then kernel chooser flips and KV memcpy jumps. repro on dedicated pool, not a single-request anomaly.

alex: can you paste the flamegraph slice? my bet is kernel-selection threshold + rope-scale interaction.

maria: pasted perf snapshot below — note the sudden memcpy/launch spikes at 520.
```
# perf slice (simplified)
seq_len 500: avg p99 23.4ms, memcpy 1.1ms
seq_len 520: avg p99 27.6ms, memcpy 5.2ms, kernel_switch overhead +2.8ms
stack: runtime::batcher -> kernel_selector -> cudaLaunchKernel -> memcpy
```

sam: +1 on kernel flip. also saw weird attention-mask gaps with sliding-window when max_position_embeddings gets interpreted differently by our RoPE scaler. mask becomes non-contiguous for cached KV and downstream kernels don't expect it.

jeff: quick mitigation proposal: (1) adjust kernel selection breakpoint from 512->576 for Mistral-8x7B so we avoid the flip in typical workload windows, (2) coalesce small KV fragments in the cache flush path, (3) clamp effective_rope_scale when sliding-window active.

maria: can we test a patch that 1) forces kernel_hint=compact for seqlen in [513,640], 2) dedups KV memcpy by merging contiguous tiles before CUDA memcpy?

alex: ran a micro-benchmark on a dev GPU. command used: `./bench_infer --model mistral-8x7b --batch 1 --prompt-len 32 --gen 500 --window 512`

alex: raw numbers before patch:
```
-- p99 27.9ms (520 tokens), memcpy 5.1ms, kernel_switch 2.9ms
-- p50 11.2ms
```

alex: after patch (kernel_hint forced + kv coalesce):
```
-- p99 23.7ms (520 tokens), memcpy 1.3ms, kernel_switch 0.4ms
-- p50 10.9ms
```

sam: huge improvement. any regressions around short sequences? we should be sure not to slow <=512 case.

jeff: I ran unit smoke across short seqs — no regressions. patch is small. also added one-line guard in rope scaler: if sliding_window && effective_rope_scale > 1.02 then clamp to 1.0 for cache-compat.

maria: can you drop the PR with perf numbers + a test that simulates KV-fragmentation pattern? add a note to the rollout doc to keep the breakpoint configurable.

jeff: PR incoming in ~30m. label: perf/m7b-8x7b-kernel-hint. will include an opt-in flag for Dedicated customers so we can toggle in prod if something odd appears.

ops-bot: deploy request created by jeff:deploy-branch perf/m7b-8x7b-kernel-hint -> staging (sha: a1b2c3d).

maria: great. follow-up items: 1) add telemetry for kernel_selector flips (per-model, per-seq-bucket), 2) run 24h soak on a couple of busy routing rules, 3) check for similar breakpoints on Mistral-7B and Mixtral variants.

alex: I'll add the kernel_flip metric to the trace and a histogram by seq_bucket. quick note — might want to also document why 512->576 chosen so SRE can reason about it.

maria: thanks all, good triage. will update the incident board if soak shows churn. :thumbsup:
